description: This file defines the LeavePeriodHistory entity class, representing records of leave period start dates within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_leave_period_history' and includes properties like start month, start day, and creation timestamp, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistory
classes.description: An entity class representing leave period history records, including metadata annotations for ORM mapping, properties for start month, start day, and creation date, and corresponding getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave period history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the record.

methods.name: getStartMonth
methods.description: Returns the start month of the leave period.

methods.name: setStartMonth
methods.description: Sets the start month of the leave period.

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Returns the start day of the leave period.

methods.name: setStartDay
methods.description: Sets the start day of the leave period.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the record was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the record.
